title: The Road Out
summary: Ilse carries Bram's salt to Karsk and learns what the Lantern Guild's fairness costs.
beats: Bram sends Ilse alone with a cart of Rock Salt and a sealed tally.
At the Karsk gate a Tidemark buyer offers twice the guild price, paid now.
Ilse appraises the salt and finds the tally overstates its weight.
She sells through the guild house at the guild's price and pays the gate toll from her own purse.
gains: Ilse learns her master shorts the tally
losses: three silver of her own coin
two points of favour with the Karsk guild house, for asking about the tally

uses.pays: The lesson fee comes due at the guild house: Ilse owes it before she can sell.

newEntities.why: The first market town on the road; the guild house is there.

statChanges.why: The Karsk gate toll, from her own purse.
She asked the guild house about the tally.
The guild ledger at the end of chapter two.
